tenderSchedule.deptName: Department For Skill Development Entrepreneurship And Livelihood
tenderSchedule.locationName: DSDEL District Skill Office Bengaluru Rural

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Dist. Skill Development office, DC Office Building, Room No. 132, 1st Floor, Beersandra Village, Devanahalli Taluk, Bangalore RuralDist.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tender inviting authority reserves the right to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning reasons
Bidders should abide to all the Terms and Conditions mentioned in the Bid Document attached
Any statutory taxers will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders
Tenderer should quote only service charge on total minimum labour wages in percentage

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should provide the information duly filled in Form-1, 2 & 3 and Annexure-2

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Form-1, 2 and 3 along with Annexure-2

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers must have registered at least 3 years back under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Registration Act-1961 in relation to providing human resource services. Attach the Valid registration certificate

Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Registration Certificate obtained at least 3 years ago. The Institution/Company/Agency should provide the documents regarding the payment of Employee Provident Fund (EPF) every month for the last 3 years (Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)

Employees State Insurance (ESI) Registration Certificate obtained at least 3 years ago. The Institution/Company/Agency should provide the documents regarding the ESI payments every month for the last 3 years (Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)

Registration certificate under the Goods and Services Tax Act and Monthly challans of service tax/GST paid for the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, ST-3 Service Tax Return/ GST Return in GST-R-3B. Attach the documents filed
Certificate of Registration under the Professional Tax Registration Act. Copies of returns filed in Form-5A for filing profession tax for Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 should be attached

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Professional tax Registration and returns

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have provided manpower services as a Human Resource Agency to Government and Non-Government organizations on outsourcing basis for a period of not less than 3 years (from 01-04-2023). At least 10 outsource staff engaged in each year from 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 should be attached copy of mandate/contract documents. Details of service experience to be submitted in Annexure-2
Enclosing the documents regarding the payments made towards the Labor Welfare Fund for the years ending December-31 of the year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

The bidder should provide income tax returns documents for the last 3 years (financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) of income tax paid. In case the income tax returns for the year 2025-26 have not been filed, the receipts/TDS challans of advance income tax paid should be submitted.

Average Annual turnover for the financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 must be not less than of Rs.40.00 Lakhs (Rs. Forty Lakhs), copies of profit and loss statement and balance sheet documents should be submitted. Submission of audit reports relating to these periods. If the full audit report for the year 2025-26 is not available, attach a Audit certificate.
Tenderer should have audited transactions of last 3 years. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 audit report and issuance of statutory auditor's certificate should be submitted. (Annexure-3)
